description: Get the full chronological timeline of one situation. A situation is an ongoing storyline (story arc) that groups related news events over time; it carries a maintained summary plus every event in order, so you see not just what happened but how it developed. Each event is a cluster (one happening assembled from many outlets and deduplicated) with its date, a significance score (1 to 10, where 8 and above is exceptional), a source count, and a canonical clstr.news link. Use this to brief on a story's history or answer 'how did this develop'. Get a situation id from search_situations or get_top_situations, or from a clstr.news URL. An id that was retired when two situations merged resolves to the successor, flagged with merged_into_shown. Results carry canonical clstr.news links.

situation_id.description: Situation id or slug (from other tools or clstr.news URLs).

timeline_before.description: Cursor: cluster id (a UUID) from a previous page, to continue past it.

timeline_limit.description: Timeline entries to return, newest first. Default 50, and 50 is also the maximum without an API key. A free key raises it to 500: https://clstr.news/developers

name: get_situation_timeline

is_timeline_page.description: True on a timeline_before continuation page, which omits the header fields.

merged_into_shown.description: Present when a retired id was served as its successor.

requested_id.description: The retired id that was asked for, alongside merged_into_shown.

significance_score.description: AI-generated significance, 1 to 10, where 8 and above is exceptional.

summary.description: The maintained situation summary, in full.

significance_score.description: AI-generated significance, 1 to 10, where 8 and above is exceptional.

sources.description: How many outlets are behind this event.

next_before.description: Pass back as timeline_before for the next page.

title: Get a situation timeline
